name: io.github.chrischall/groupon-mcp
description: Groupon deals for Claude — search and browse local, goods, and travel deals

environmentVariables.name: GROUPON_SESSION_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional, and only for the cart tools. Leave unset to have the ContextMint Bridge browser extension pick up your signed-in groupon.com session. Otherwise paste the full Cookie request header from a signed-in www.groupon.com /mobilenextapi/graphql request (DevTools → Network). It authorizes changes to your Groupon cart, so treat it like a password.

environmentVariables.name: GROUPON_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true to disable the fetchproxy browser-bridge fallback (then the cart path relies solely on GROUPON_SESSION_COOKIE).

environmentVariables.name: GROUPON_GRAPHQL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the GraphQL endpoint (defaults to https://www.groupon.com/mobilenextapi/graphql). The cart tools send your session cookie, so they refuse any override that is not an https://*.groupon.com URL.

environmentVariables.name: GROUPON_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Response-cache TTL for reads in seconds (0 = off; default 60).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
